name: ABC Python SHA-256 research binding
encoding_contract: Single-byte-item buffers are accepted. SHA-256 returns immutable 32-byte digests.
error_contract: TypeError for invalid buffers, ValueError for lifecycle errors, OverflowError for input overflow, and MemoryError for native allocation failure.
ownership_contract: Each streaming object owns one native context, serializes calls, and frees it on close or collection.
